# Zavera.Tech — Language Model Context & AI Search Index

> Zavera.Tech is a premier software development house, IT company, and creative digital agency headquartered in Abbottabad, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. We partner with startups, local enterprises, and growing organizations worldwide to engineer scalable web platforms, execute technical SEO strategies, and build brand identities.

## Primary Location & Contact
- City: Abbottabad, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
- Website: https://zavera-tech.vercel.app
- Email: contact@zavera.tech

## Core Services & Capabilities
1. Modern Web Development:
   - Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, and Node.js
   - High-performance, SEO-optimized business websites and full-stack web applications
   - Headless CMS and enterprise API integrations
2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO):
   - Actionable Technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals optimization
   - Local SEO dominance in Abbottabad, Hazara Division, and Pakistan
   - JSON-LD Structured Data, On-Page SEO, and search intent keyword mapping
3. Digital Marketing:
   - Performance marketing, full-funnel customer acquisition, and conversion rate optimization (CRO)
   - Social media marketing and targeted PPC campaigns
4. Graphic Designing & Brand Identity:
   - Corporate visual systems, vector logos, style manuals, and UX/UI design
